businesses.business: regulated electric, gas and steam utilities

offering_description.value: Delivers electricity, natural gas and steam to residential, commercial and government customers through regulated utilities, mainly in New York City and Westchester County, and through Orange and Rockland in nearby areas. It owns and operates the transmission and distribution networks. It also holds smaller clean energy generation and transmission investments.

primary_services.value: electric delivery; gas distribution; steam distribution; renewable energy project development

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric and gas customers in New York City, Westchester and surrounding areas; B2B: commercial, industrial and building customers, including steam customers in Manhattan; B2G: municipal and government facilities, transit and public agencies

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial real estate; transportation; public sector; industrial

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated rates for electricity, gas and steam delivered, based on customer usage; product sales: commodity energy supply passed through to customers; project or contract: clean energy projects sold under long-term contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs electric, gas and steam delivery networks, selling to end customers; service provider: buys power and gas and delivers it to retail customers

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City, Westchester County, and parts of New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania via Orange and Rockland

specialization.value: related lines: electric, gas and steam delivery utilities plus clean energy investments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility lines and pipes billing customers directly; online: online account and billing services

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates and operations regulated by the New York and other state public service commissions, FERC and NERC
